title: Social graph collection input
description: Collects follower/following identity lists. The targets array ({platform, username} pairs) is validated authoritatively by the actor code: trimmed usernames, leading @ stripped, duplicates by (platform, normalizedUsername) rejected, platform limited to instagram/x/tiktok, at most 100 targets.
